# Paper Readiness Checklist

- [ ] Primary claim is one sentence and matches the evidence level.
- [ ] Main baseline/evaluation protocol is frozen and reproducible.
- [ ] Strong external baselines cover relevant method classes.
- [ ] Test set was not repeatedly tuned on.
- [ ] Per-sample/replicate statistics support mean claims.
- [ ] Key ablations isolate claimed contributions.
- [ ] Negative/invalid historical results are classified correctly.
- [ ] Dataset/annotation protocol differences are disclosed.
- [ ] Qualitative figures compare fixed/moving/warped or equivalent evidence, not attractive standalone outputs.
- [ ] Runtime/parameters/memory use fair conditions.
- [ ] Limitations and failure cases are included.
- [ ] Code/checkpoint/data availability and provenance plan exists.
- [ ] Every strong statement can be traced to a result or source.
